jobs.prompt: Use the attached concept board ONLY as art and design reference. Produce an actual game-ready asset, not a board or screenshot. Match its restrained handmade layered watercolor/gouache paint and irregular dark ink contour style. SUNSEED GARDEN: buttercream sage citron warm brown ink and soft peach; sunny moss garden, cream hooded human with a visible friendly face, olive seed backpack, ochre scarf; pointed coral flower sentinel with a dark central core; pale sage leaf buds; mossy stones and plump botanical leaves. No writing, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. A transparent sprite atlas, 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, EXACTLY TWELVE objects, each isolated and centered within its own grid cell with generous transparent padding. All objects seen in the SAME elevated three-quarter game camera. No ground plane and no cast shadows. Uniform cell grid, no object crosses a cell boundary. Each object's lowest point is at 88 percent of its cell height. Max object width 78% and max height 78% of cell. ROW 1, left to right: (1) round mossy solid rock island with theme plants; (2) rounded solid shell/stone obstacle; (3) small low decorative leafy sprig; (4) harmless CLOSED seed bud. ROW 2, left to right: the SAME human survivor four standing poses, (5) FRONT facing viewer, (6) BACK facing away, (7) SIDE profile facing RIGHT, (8) THREE QUARTER facing RIGHT and slightly toward viewer. Every survivor has identical head/body size, TWO arms and TWO legs, feet visibly separate, compact cute proportions as in attached board, entire body visible. ROW 3, left to right: (9) ACTIVE floating sentinel facing viewer with opened pointed petals, (10) SAME active sentinel side profile facing right, (11) single collectible golden teardrop seed without petals and clearly different from dormant bud, (12) taller border plant cluster. Flat transparent background throughout. No scene. Fine but strong outlines so these sprites read at 40 pixels. Landscape 4:3 image.
